checks.text: On first load, the page shows the heading "Trip Cost Calculator" and the text "No saved trips yet" in the Saved Trips tab.

In the tab labelled "Calculator", typing "300" in the field labelled "Distance (miles)", "30" in the field labelled "MPG", and "4.50" in the field labelled "Fuel price ($/gal)" updates the result summary to show "Total fuel cost: $45.00" and "Gallons needed: 10.00".
In the tab labelled "Calculator", with Distance "300", MPG "30", and Fuel price "4.50", the breakdown table shows a row with "Gallons" and "10.00" and a row with "Cost" and "$45.00".

In the tab labelled "Calculator", with Distance "300", MPG "30", and Fuel price "4.50", clicking the button "Save trip" adds a list item in the tab labelled "Saved Trips" that contains "300 miles" and "$45.00".
In the tab labelled "Saved Trips", with the saved trip from A4 present, clicking the button "Delete 300 miles" removes that list item and the text "No saved trips yet" reappears.
In the tab labelled "Calculator", with Distance "300", MPG "30", and Fuel price "4.50", clicking the button "Copy result" shows the toast text "Result copied to clipboard".

In the tab labelled "Calculator", changing the field labelled "Fuel price ($/gal)" from "4.50" to "5.00" while Distance is "300" and MPG is "30" updates the result summary to show "Total fuel cost: $50.00".
In the tab labelled "Calculator", typing "0" in the field labelled "Distance (miles)" shows the message "Distance must be greater than 0" and the result summary shows "Total fuel cost: $0.00".

Reload keeps the saved trip: after saving a trip with Distance "300", MPG "30", and Fuel price "4.50" (showing "$45.00"), reloading the page still shows the list item in the tab labelled "Saved Trips" containing "300 miles" and "$45.00".
